records.name: LangChain
records.description: Open-source Python and JavaScript framework for building LLM-powered applications and agents. Provides composable abstractions for chains, tools, memory, and retrieval to streamline AI application development.
records.resource_subtype: Agent Framework
records.notes: Core framework is MIT-licensed and free. LangSmith (observability) and LangGraph Cloud (managed orchestration) are separate commercial products from LangChain Inc. LangGraph (graph-based agent orchestration) is a distinct but closely related project cataloged separately.

records.name: LlamaIndex
records.description: Open-source data framework for building RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) applications. Provides data ingestion, indexing, retrieval, and query engines for connecting LLMs to external documents and data sources.
records.resource_subtype: RAG Framework
records.notes: Core framework is MIT-licensed. LlamaCloud is a commercial managed service for production RAG pipelines offered by LlamaIndex (formerly Jerry Liu's company). Formerly known as GPT Index before rebranding to LlamaIndex.

records.name: Qdrant
records.description: High-performance vector database and similarity search engine built in Rust for storing, indexing, and querying vector embeddings. Designed for semantic search, RAG, and AI application backends with filtering support.
records.resource_subtype: Vector Database
records.notes: Core engine is Apache 2.0 licensed and freely self-hostable. Qdrant Cloud is a managed, fully-hosted offering with a free tier (1GB cluster). Supports sparse vectors, payload filtering, and multi-tenancy. Written in Rust for performance and memory safety.

records.name: Ollama
records.description: Open-source runtime for running large language models locally on macOS, Windows, and Linux. Exposes an OpenAI-compatible REST API, supports NVIDIA/AMD GPU acceleration, and manages model downloads via a curated library.
records.resource_subtype: Local LLM Runtime
records.notes: MIT-licensed. Supports CUDA (NVIDIA), ROCm (AMD), and Metal (Apple Silicon) acceleration. Modelfile system enables custom model configuration. Provides a Docker image for server deployments. Works with Llama, Qwen, Gemma, Mistral, and many other open-weight model families.

records.name: vLLM
records.description: High-throughput LLM inference and serving engine using PagedAttention for efficient GPU memory management. Provides OpenAI-compatible APIs, continuous batching, and support for distributed multi-GPU inference.
records.resource_subtype: Model Serving Engine
records.notes: Apache 2.0 licensed. Key innovation is PagedAttention — a memory management technique enabling 24x higher throughput vs naive implementations. Supports tensor parallelism and pipeline parallelism for multi-GPU deployments. Widely used in production LLM serving.

records.name: Hugging Face Hub
records.description: Central platform for hosting, discovering, and sharing AI models, datasets, and Spaces. Provides Git-based model versioning, model cards, inference APIs, and a collaborative ecosystem for the ML community.
records.resource_subtype: Model Registry and Collaboration Platform
records.notes: Core public model/dataset hosting is free. Pro plan (\$9/month) adds storage and compute credits. Enterprise plan starts at \$50/user/month with SSO, audit logs, and private regions. A self-hosted Enterprise Hub version exists but is distinct from the public platform.

records.name: Pinecone
records.description: Fully managed serverless vector database for semantic search, recommendation systems, and RAG applications. Provides automatic scaling, filtered search, and multi-tenancy with pay-per-use billing for reads, writes, and storage.
records.resource_subtype: Vector Database
records.notes: Fully managed cloud service only — no self-hosting option. Free Starter plan includes 2GB storage and limited usage. Standard production plans have a usage-based pricing model with read units, write units, and storage metering. Transitioned to serverless architecture in 2024.

records.name: Weaviate
records.description: Open-source vector database with native multi-modal support, hybrid search (dense + sparse), and built-in ML model integrations. Supports semantic search, question answering, and classification at scale.
records.resource_subtype: Vector Database
records.notes: Core engine is BSD-3-Clause licensed (open-source). Weaviate Cloud (WCD) is a managed service with a free sandbox tier. Supports GraphQL and REST APIs. Includes built-in vectorizer modules for OpenAI, Cohere, HuggingFace embeddings.

records.name: LangGraph
records.description: Graph-based orchestration framework for building stateful multi-step AI agents with fine-grained control over loops, branching, and persistence. Designed for reliable, controllable agentic application workflows.
records.resource_subtype: Agent Orchestration Framework
records.notes: Developed and maintained by LangChain Inc. MIT-licensed open-source library. LangGraph Cloud is a separate commercial managed deployment product. Distinct from LangChain (cataloged separately) — LangGraph focuses on stateful, cyclical workflows for agents.

records.name: CrewAI
records.description: Open-source Python framework for orchestrating autonomous AI agent teams. Enables role-based agent design, task delegation, memory sharing, and tool integration for complex multi-agent collaborative workflows.
records.resource_subtype: Multi-Agent Framework
records.notes: Core Python framework is MIT-licensed. CrewAI Enterprise offers managed cloud deployment at custom pricing. Free plan on CrewAI cloud includes ~50 executions/month. Integrates with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and A2A (Agent-to-Agent) communication protocols.

records.name: Langfuse
records.description: Open-source LLM observability and tracing platform for debugging, monitoring, and evaluating LLM applications. Provides trace visualization, prompt management, evaluation workflows, and cost analytics.
records.resource_subtype: LLM Observability Platform
records.notes: Core platform is MIT-licensed and self-hostable (via Docker). Langfuse Cloud offers a free Hobby tier (50K traces/month, 30-day retention). Core plan at \$29/month, Pro at \$199/month. Enterprise self-hosted plans available with SSO and advanced RBAC.

records.name: OpenAI API Platform
records.description: OpenAI's developer API platform providing programmatic access to GPT-4o, o1, Whisper, DALL·E, Embeddings, and Assistants API. Enables integration of OpenAI models into third-party applications and workflows.
records.resource_subtype: AI API Platform
records.notes: Distinct from the ChatGPT consumer product (tool:chatgpt) and from individual OpenAI models. Pricing is purely usage-based (per-token and per-request). Provides API access to all current OpenAI models including reasoning (o-series), GPT-4o, vision, TTS, ASR, embeddings, and image generation.

records.name: Anthropic API
records.description: Anthropic's developer API providing access to Claude model family for text generation, vision, tool use, and document analysis. Offers usage-based token pricing and safety-focused model behavior.
records.resource_subtype: AI API Platform
records.notes: Distinct from Claude consumer product (tool:claude) and individual Claude model records. API access requires signup and payment method. Supports Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Claude 3.5 Haiku, and Claude 3 Opus. Available on AWS Bedrock and Google Cloud Vertex AI as third-party integrations.

records.name: llama.cpp
records.description: C/C++ inference framework for running large language models locally using GGUF quantized model formats. Supports CPU-only inference with optional GPU acceleration on CUDA, Metal, Vulkan, and ROCm backends.
records.resource_subtype: Local LLM Inference Engine
records.notes: MIT-licensed. Originally created by Georgi Gerganov; repository moved to ggml-org organization. The GGUF model format originated from this project. Foundation for many local LLM tools including Ollama. Supports LLaMA, Mistral, Gemma, Qwen, and many other architectures.

records.name: Chroma
records.description: Open-source embedding database for AI applications. Provides a developer-friendly API for storing, querying, and managing embeddings locally or in a client-server deployment, with native Python and JavaScript clients.
records.resource_subtype: Vector Database
records.notes: Apache 2.0 licensed. Designed primarily for prototyping and local-first development. Chroma Cloud (managed service) is in development. Popular choice for RAG prototyping due to its simple in-memory and persistent local modes. Distinct from Pinecone and Weaviate in its local-first, developer-friendly philosophy.

records.name: AutoGen
records.description: Microsoft Research's open-source framework for building event-driven, distributed multi-agent AI systems. Supports asynchronous messaging, agent teams, human-in-the-loop workflows, and cross-language agent communication.
records.resource_subtype: Multi-Agent Framework
records.notes: MIT-licensed. AutoGen 0.4 (released 2024) introduced a redesigned asynchronous, event-driven architecture. Supports Python and .NET agents. AutoGen Studio is a no-code UI companion. Distinct from LangGraph and CrewAI in its emphasis on distributed, asynchronous agent communication patterns.

records.name: Replicate
records.description: Cloud platform for running AI models via API with pay-per-use pricing. Hosts thousands of open-source and official AI models for image generation, video, language, and audio tasks without infrastructure management.
records.resource_subtype: AI Model Hosting Platform
records.notes: Pure usage-based pricing — no free tier beyond an initial credit allowance. Billing by hardware-seconds (for community models) or by output units (for official models). Cog is Replicate's open-source tool for packaging custom models. Supports private model deployment with autoscaling.

records.name: Model Context Protocol SDK
records.description: Open standard and software development kit introduced by Anthropic that standardizes how AI applications and agents securely access external context, enterprise databases, file systems, and API tools over JSON-RPC.
records.resource_subtype: Open Agent Protocol Specification and SDK
records.notes: MIT-licensed open standard. Eliminates custom point-to-point integrations by providing reusable server and client abstractions implemented across Python, TypeScript, and Kotlin.

records.name: LiteLLM
records.description: Open-source AI proxy and gateway that unifies calls to 100+ LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, Vertex, Ollama) using the standard OpenAI input-output format, handling load balancing, fallbacks, and cost tracking.
records.resource_subtype: Universal Model Proxy & Routing Gateway
records.notes: Core proxy is MIT-licensed. LiteLLM Enterprise offers dedicated virtual key management, SSO, rate limits, and custom billing dashboards for production deployments.

records.name: SGLang
records.description: High-throughput serving engine and programming language for large language models. Optimizes complex prompt workflows, multi-turn chat loops, and constrained JSON decodings with RadixAttention KV-cache reuse.
records.resource_subtype: Fast Serving Engine & Structured Decoding Framework
records.notes: Apache 2.0 licensed. Developed by researchers from LMSYS and UC Berkeley. RadixAttention retains KV-caches across multiple API calls, significantly speeding up complex reasoning and agent workflows.

records.name: TensorRT-LLM
records.description: Open-source Python and C++ inference optimization library engineered by NVIDIA. Compiles and executes large language models with kernel fusions, in-flight batching, FP8 quantization, and multi-GPU tensor parallelism.
records.resource_subtype: GPU-Accelerated LLM Inference Library
records.notes: Released under the Apache 2.0 license. Powers NVIDIA NIM microservices. Maximizes token throughput and minimizes first-token latency on NVIDIA Hopper (H100/H200) and Blackwell hardware architectures.

records.name: Unsloth
records.description: High-speed, memory-efficient fine-tuning library for open-weight models (Llama, Mistral, Qwen, Gemma). Uses custom hand-written GPU Triton kernels to speed up LoRA and QLoRA training by up to 5x while reducing VRAM usage by 80%.
records.resource_subtype: Accelerated LLM Fine-Tuning Library
records.notes: Core software open-source under Apache 2.0. Unsloth Pro and Enterprise provide multi-GPU distributed fine-tuning and commercial support. Enables fine-tuning large 70B parameter models on modest GPU configurations.

records.name: Axolotl
records.description: Config-driven tool designed to streamline the post-training and fine-tuning of foundation language models. Supports full fine-tuning, LoRA, QLoRA, DPO, and PPO via simple YAML configurations across multi-GPU setups.
records.resource_subtype: Post-Training & Fine-Tuning Framework
records.notes: Apache 2.0 licensed. Supports FlashAttention, xFormers, DeepSpeed, and FSDP natively. Serves as a standard training harness for open-source AI researchers and community model builders.

records.name: DSPy
records.description: Stanford University's open-source framework for programmatically optimizing language model prompts and weights. Replaces brittle hand-written prompt templates with modular Python signatures that are compiled and auto-tuned algorithmically.
records.resource_subtype: Algorithmic Prompt Optimization Framework
records.notes: MIT-licensed. Treats LLM pipelines as parameterized programs with automated optimizers (Teleprompters / MIPRO) that systematically discover high-performing few-shot demonstrations and prompt variations.

records.name: OpenRouter
records.description: Unified API gateway that aggregates hundreds of proprietary and open-weight AI models through a single OpenAI-compatible interface, offering automated fallback routing, competitive per-token pricing, and transparent latency benchmarks.
records.resource_subtype: Unified LLM Routing & Aggregation Platform
records.notes: Purely usage-based without subscriptions; charges exact upstream provider costs plus minimal transaction margins. Supports crypto and fiat credit top-ups. Includes a free tier for select open-source models.

records.name: Together AI
records.description: High-performance cloud platform providing fast API inference for open-source AI models, dedicated GPU compute clusters, and custom model fine-tuning environments with enterprise SOC 2 compliance.
records.resource_subtype: Accelerated Cloud Inference & Training Platform
records.notes: Billed on per-token consumption for serverless endpoints and per-hour rates for dedicated H100 GPU clusters. Known for high token-per-second inference speeds powered by custom flash-attention kernels.

records.name: Groq Cloud
records.description: Ultra-fast AI inference platform powered by custom Language Processing Unit (LPU) semiconductor hardware. Serves open-weight LLMs, vision, and Whisper transcription models at hundreds of tokens per second with near-instant response times.
records.resource_subtype: LPU Ultra-Low Latency Inference Engine
records.notes: Provides a free tier with daily rate limits. Paid Pay-As-You-Go tier charges standard per-million-token consumption. LPU deterministic architecture avoids typical GPU queuing jitter, enabling real-time conversational voice agents.

records.name: Modal
records.description: Serverless cloud infrastructure platform that allows developers to run Python code, containerized AI workloads, batch model inference, and fine-tuning jobs on cloud GPUs with sub-second cold starts and per-second billing.
records.resource_subtype: Serverless Cloud Compute Platform for AI
records.notes: Includes $30/month in free compute credits for all users. Billed strictly by execution seconds across CPU, memory, and GPU (T4, A10G, L4, A100, H100) allocations. Container environments are defined directly in native Python code.

records.name: RunPod
records.description: Cloud computing provider specializing in affordable GPU rental pods, distributed training clusters, and serverless AI worker endpoints for deploying inference APIs, image generators, and machine learning models globally.
records.resource_subtype: Distributed Cloud GPU & Serverless AI Platform
records.notes: Offers Secure Cloud (Tier 3/4 data centers) and Community Cloud (budget pricing). Billed by the minute/second. Serverless GPU endpoints automatically scale to zero when idle to save infrastructure costs.

records.name: Braintrust
records.description: Enterprise evaluation, tracing, and prompt-engineering platform for LLM applications. Provides CI/CD regression testing, dataset curation, automated scoring, real-time production monitoring, and prompt playground environments.
records.resource_subtype: Enterprise AI Evaluation & Tracing Platform
records.notes: Free plan includes unlimited seats and a monthly allotment of evaluation records and traces. Pro plan ($50/month) and Enterprise plans offer custom retention, SSO, private cloud deployments, and dedicated support.

records.name: Arize Phoenix
records.description: Open-source AI observability library and dashboard for tracing LLM execution steps, evaluating RAG retrieval pipelines, troubleshooting hallucination rates, and benchmarking agent execution graphs using OpenTelemetry standards.
records.resource_subtype: Open-Source AI Tracing & Evaluation Platform
records.notes: Released under Apache 2.0 license. Can be run entirely locally inside a Jupyter notebook or Docker container without transmitting telemetry to third-party clouds. Arize Cloud provides managed SaaS hosting.

records.name: Guardrails AI
records.description: Open-source Python and JavaScript framework that enforces structural guarantees, type safety, PII redaction, toxicity filtering, and prompt injection defense on LLM inputs and outputs using community-authored validators.
records.resource_subtype: LLM Output Validation & Security Framework
records.notes: Core framework is Apache 2.0 licensed. Operates Guardrails Hub, a marketplace of pre-built validators (regex matching, hallucination detection, schema compliance). Guardrails Server provides a containerized microservice API.

records.name: pgvector
records.description: Open-source vector similarity search extension for PostgreSQL. Stores exact and approximate nearest-neighbor vector embeddings alongside relational relational records using HNSW and IVFFlat indexing methods.
records.resource_subtype: Vector Similarity Search Extension for PostgreSQL
records.notes: Distributed under the PostgreSQL License. Widely deployed across AWS RDS, Supabase, Neon, Azure PostgreSQL, and self-hosted database clusters to consolidate vectors and transactional data in a single ACID engine.

records.name: LanceDB
records.description: Developer-friendly, serverless open-source vector database built on the columnar Lance data format. Supports disk-native vector search, multi-modal storage, hybrid retrieval, and zero-infrastructure local embedding storage.
records.resource_subtype: Embedded Multimodal Vector Database
records.notes: Apache 2.0 licensed. Can run serverlessly in-process (like DuckDB or SQLite) embedded directly in Python/Node applications, querying disk and object storage (S3/GCS) without dedicated database servers. LanceDB Cloud offers enterprise managed hosting.

records.name: Milvus
records.description: Open-source cloud-native distributed vector database designed to manage and search tens of billions of vector embeddings in milliseconds. Built with decoupled storage and compute for massive enterprise scale.
records.resource_subtype: Cloud-Native Distributed Vector Database
records.notes: Graduated LF AI & Data Foundation project under Apache 2.0. Zilliz Cloud provides the fully managed enterprise cloud edition. Supports HNSW, IVF, and GPU-accelerated indexes (Knowhere).

records.name: Faiss
records.description: Open-source C++ and Python library developed by Meta Fundamental AI Research for efficient dense vector clustering and similarity search across billion-scale datasets with complete GPU acceleration and quantization support.
records.resource_subtype: Dense Vector Similarity Search Library
records.notes: MIT-licensed. Foundational low-level algorithm library underlying many production vector databases and retrieval systems. Features Product Quantization (PQ) and Inverted File (IVF) indexes.

records.name: Haystack
records.description: Production-ready open-source Python framework from deepset for constructing customizable RAG pipelines, semantic search engines, and agent workflows using a typed, directed acyclic graph (DAG) component architecture.
records.resource_subtype: Modular LLM Orchestration Framework
records.notes: Apache 2.0 licensed. Haystack 2.0 features modular component connections, flexible document store adapters, and seamless integration with deepset Cloud for enterprise deployments.

records.name: txtai
records.description: Open-source all-in-one embeddings database that combines vector indexing, relational SQL storage, document extraction, and graph networks to power semantic search, knowledge graphs, and LLM orchestration.
records.resource_subtype: All-in-One Embeddings Database & Search Engine
records.notes: Apache 2.0 licensed. Developed by NeuML. Enables querying multimodal data and knowledge graphs using standard SQL syntax combined with vector similarity matching.

records.name: RAGFlow
records.description: Open-source RAG engine based on deep document understanding. Extracts and parses unstructured data from complex multi-column PDFs, financial tables, slides, and scanned forms with vision-based document layout analysis.
records.resource_subtype: Deep Document Understanding RAG Engine
records.notes: Apache 2.0 licensed by InfiniFlow. Solves the "garbage in, garbage out" challenge in RAG by visualizing document chunks and preserving tabular structure across multi-page corporate PDFs.

records.name: Microsoft GraphRAG
records.description: Modular RAG pipeline developed by Microsoft Research that extracts structured knowledge graphs and entity communities from unstructured text documents, enabling holistic global summarization over entire private corpuses.
records.resource_subtype: Knowledge Graph-Enhanced RAG Pipeline
records.notes: MIT-licensed. Addresses standard vector RAG's failure to answer query-focused global questions (e.g., "What are the major themes across all 50 reports?") by leveraging hierarchical Leiden community detection.

records.name: Dify
records.description: Open-source platform combining Backend-as-a-Service and visual workflow orchestration for AI applications. Enables teams to visually build multi-agent systems, complex RAG pipelines, and API integrations with one-click deployment.
records.resource_subtype: Open-Source LLM App Development Platform
records.license: Apache 2.0 with commercial restrictions (Dify Open Source License)
records.notes: Open-source under Apache 2.0 with commercial restrictions in the Dify Open Source License. Easily deployed via Docker Compose. Dify Cloud provides a managed SaaS offering with free sandbox credits.

records.name: Flowise
records.description: Open-source drag-and-drop UI tool built on LangChain.js that enables developers to visually configure LLM chains, conversational agents, custom tool integrations, memory nodes, and vector database embeddings.
records.resource_subtype: Drag-and-Drop LLM Flow Builder
records.notes: MIT-licensed. Built using Node.js and React. Deploys as an independent container or npm package, exposing finished flows as embeddable chat widgets or REST API endpoints.

records.name: Langflow
records.description: Visual, Python-based web UI framework designed for prototyping and testing multi-agent workflows, custom prompt chains, and RAG architectures with live execution tracing and reusable component building blocks.
records.resource_subtype: Visual Framework for Multi-Agent & RAG Systems
records.notes: Acquired by DataStax. MIT-licensed. Every visual block corresponds directly to Python code that developers can inspect, customize, and export into production applications.

records.name: n8n
records.description: Fair-code workflow automation platform that integrates 400+ business applications with native LangChain AI nodes, enabling developers to build autonomous AI agents, chat triggers, and custom data sync pipelines.
records.resource_subtype: Self-Hostable Workflow Automation with AI Agents
records.notes: Source-available under Sustainable Use License (free for self-hosted internal business use). n8n Cloud offers managed tiers. AI Agent node supports conversational memory, tools, and sub-workflows.

records.name: LM Studio
records.description: Cross-platform desktop application for discovering, downloading, and running quantized LLMs (GGUF format) completely offline on macOS, Windows, and Linux, exposing a local OpenAI-compatible REST server.
records.resource_subtype: Local Model Desktop Environment & Server
records.notes: Free for personal use; commercial deployment requires LM Studio for Work license. Connects directly to Hugging Face to search and pull quantized model weights with automatic hardware GPU offloading.

records.name: LocalAI
records.description: Free, open-source drop-in replacement REST API compatible with OpenAI specifications for local and edge inference. Runs text generation, vision, audio transcription, image generation, and embeddings without requiring cloud connectivity.
records.resource_subtype: Drop-in Self-Hosted OpenAI API Alternative
records.notes: MIT-licensed. Built by Ettore Di Giacinto (mudler). Supports multiple backends including llama.cpp, Whisper.cpp, Diffusers, and ONNX inside standard Docker containers on consumer CPUs and GPUs.

records.name: Jan
records.description: 100% open-source, privacy-first desktop application and local API server that runs LLMs locally on personal hardware. Stores all conversations, models, and embeddings locally on disk without telemetry tracking.
records.resource_subtype: Open-Source Offline Local AI Desktop Client
records.notes: AGPL-3.0 licensed. Developed by Menhir. Powered by the Nitro inference engine (C++). Exposes a local HTTP server at `http://localhost:1337` mimicking OpenAI chat endpoints for local development.

records.name: MLX
records.description: Efficient machine learning framework designed specifically for Apple Silicon by Apple machine learning research. Features unified memory architecture exploitation, multi-device array operations, and lazy evaluation for fast local inference.
records.resource_subtype: Machine Learning Framework for Apple Silicon
records.notes: MIT-licensed. Uses Python and C++ APIs designed intentionally similar to NumPy and PyTorch. Powers `mlx-lm` for running high-parameter LLMs locally with high throughput on M1/M2/M3/M4 MacBooks.

records.name: DeepEval
records.description: Open-source evaluation and unit testing framework for LLM applications. Provides production-grade metrics for evaluating hallucination, answer relevancy, faithfulness, G-Eval, and prompt injection defense within CI/CD pipelines.
records.resource_subtype: Unit Testing & Evaluation Framework for LLM Apps
records.notes: Apache 2.0 licensed. Designed to integrate directly with `pytest` for automated regression testing of prompt updates, model swaps, and retrieval adjustments. Confident AI provides cloud tracking dashboards.

records.name: Ragas
records.description: Open-source framework tailored for evaluating Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems. Computes reference-free scores for context precision, context recall, faithfulness, and answer relevance to pinpoint retrieval versus generation failures.
records.resource_subtype: Automated Evaluation Framework for RAG Pipelines
records.notes: Apache 2.0 licensed. Developed by Exploding Gradients. Features synthetic test dataset generation capabilities using document corpuses to automate comprehensive RAG benchmark suites.

records.name: NeMo Guardrails
records.description: Open-source toolkit developed by NVIDIA for adding programmable guardrails to LLM conversational systems. Enforces topical boundaries, blocks jailbreak attempts, checks factual consistency, and prevents hallucinated statements using Colang scripts.
records.resource_subtype: Conversational Safety & Programmable Rails Toolkit
records.notes: Apache 2.0 licensed. Uses the modeling language Colang to define topical flows and dialog rules. Can run locally alongside any LLM (LangChain, LlamaIndex, LiteLLM) to govern input/output interactions before reaching end-users.

records.name: Baseten
records.description: Serverless and dedicated model deployment platform for machine learning teams. Provides autoscaling GPU infrastructure, ultra-fast cold starts, and custom engine packaging (Truss) for serving open-source foundation models in production.
records.resource_subtype: High-Performance Model Serving & Cloud Inference Platform
records.notes: Billed by actual GPU execution seconds (A10G, A100, H100). Truss is Baseten's open-source packaging standard. Powers production inference for top AI applications including Patreon and Descript.

records.name: Fireworks AI
records.description: Cloud inference platform engineered by former Meta PyTorch engineers. Serves frontier open-weight models (Llama 3.1, Mixtral, Qwen) with sub-second latency and high token throughput, supporting serverless LoRA adapter switching.
records.resource_subtype: High-Throughput Production AI Inference Platform
records.notes: Consumption-based per-token pricing with $1 in free credits upon registration. Known for FireAttention—custom flash attention kernels that enable low-cost multi-tenant serving of fine-tuned LoRA models.

records.name: DeepInfra
records.description: Cost-effective serverless AI inference platform offering OpenAI-compatible API access to open-source LLMs, embeddings, Whisper transcription, and image generation models with pay-per-token and pay-per-second billing.
records.resource_subtype: Serverless AI Model Hosting & Inference API
records.notes: Highly competitive pay-as-you-go pricing without monthly commitments. Transparent status dashboard displaying real-time generation latency and tokens-per-second throughput metrics.

records.name: Cerebras Cloud
records.description: Ultra-high-speed AI inference platform powered by Cerebras CS-3 Wafer-Scale Engine hardware. Generates text completions for open-weight models like Llama 3.1 at sustained speeds exceeding 1,800 tokens per second.
records.resource_subtype: Wafer-Scale Ultra-Fast LLM Inference Engine
records.notes: Free tier available with rate limits for developer experimentation. Developer and Enterprise plans charge per-token consumption. World's largest silicon chips eliminate GPU inter-chip memory bottlenecks to set record token generation speeds.

records.name: Lambda Cloud
records.description: Developer-focused cloud computing platform providing on-demand and reserved access to NVIDIA GPU instances (H100, A100, GH200, L40S) with pre-installed deep learning environments, PyTorch drivers, and high-speed InfiniBand networking.
records.resource_subtype: On-Demand Deep Learning GPU Cloud
records.notes: Billed by the hour/minute with transparent pricing significantly lower than legacy hyperscalers. Offers 1-Click Clusters with quantum InfiniBand fabrics for multi-node LLM pre-training and distributed fine-tuning.

records.name: CoreWeave
records.description: Specialized cloud provider engineered for large-scale GPU workloads and AI infrastructure. Delivers massive clusters of NVIDIA H100 and H200 Tensor Core GPUs with low-latency InfiniBand interconnects for foundation model training and serving.
records.resource_subtype: Specialized Large-Scale AI Cloud Hyperscaler
records.notes: Tier 1 NVIDIA cloud partner. Tailored for enterprise foundation model companies (powers Mistral AI, NovelAI, and enterprise hyperscale clients). Requires enterprise contractual agreements or reserved instance commitments.

records.name: Vast.ai
records.description: Global peer-to-peer compute marketplace offering discounted GPU rental instances for machine learning, model fine-tuning, and batch inference. Allows users to browse and spin up Docker containers on community-hosted hardware worldwide.
records.resource_subtype: Global Peer-to-Peer GPU Cloud Marketplace
records.notes: Offers both interruptible spot pricing and on-demand rentals at fractions of traditional cloud costs. Provides command-line CLI, python client, and web console to deploy customized Docker templates.

records.name: Text Generation Inference (TGI)
records.description: Production-ready toolkit developed by Hugging Face for deploying and serving large language models. Features continuous batching, streaming tokens over Server-Sent Events, flash-attention, tensor parallelism, and watermarking.
records.resource_subtype: Production LLM Serving Engine
records.notes: Apache 2.0 licensed. Written in Rust, C++, and Python. Powers Hugging Face Inference Endpoints and native deployments for Llama, Mistral, Falcon, StarCoder, and Qwen models.

records.name: Triton Inference Server
records.description: Open-source multi-framework inference serving software created by NVIDIA. Standardizes AI model deployment across CPU and GPU hardware, supporting PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX, TensorRT, and Python backends with dynamic batching.
records.resource_subtype: Open-Source Multi-Framework Inference Serving Engine
records.notes: BSD-3-Clause licensed. Provides GRPC and HTTP endpoints, concurrent model execution, model ensembling, and integrations with Kubernetes through KServe and cloud marketplaces.

records.name: KServe
records.description: Highly scalable, cloud-native model inference platform for Kubernetes. Provides serverless model serving with autoscaling down to zero, GPU autoscaling, canary rollouts, payload logging, and unified v2 data plane protocols.
records.resource_subtype: Cloud-Native Model Inference Platform on Kubernetes
records.notes: Apache 2.0 licensed CNCF and Linux Foundation project. Formerly KFServing (Kubeflow). Serves as the enterprise standard for orchestrating deep learning models at scale in cloud-native Kubernetes environments.

records.name: BentoML
records.description: Open-source framework for building reliable, production-ready AI services. Packages models into standardized deployable containers with adaptive batching, multi-model pipeline orchestration, and built-in OpenAI-compatible API generation.
records.resource_subtype: Unified Framework for Building & Shipping AI Services
records.notes: Apache 2.0 licensed. BentoCloud provides serverless and dedicated cloud infrastructure management. Allows developers to write Python service classes that handle inference, preprocessing, and model pipelines with zero boilerplate.

records.name: Ray Serve
records.description: Scalable model serving library built on the Ray distributed computing framework. Enables multi-node model composition, independent worker scaling for preprocessing versus inference, and complex distributed pipeline orchestration.
records.resource_subtype: Programmable Distributed Model Serving Library
records.notes: Apache 2.0 licensed. Developed originally by UC Berkeley RISELab, commercially maintained by Anyscale. Ideal for orchestrating heterogeneous pipelines mixing LLMs, computer vision, and CPU business logic.

records.name: Weights & Biases (W&B)
records.description: Developer platform for machine learning teams providing experiment tracking, dataset versioning, model registry, hyperparameter tuning, and LLM evaluation (W&B Weave) with lightweight Python SDK integrations.
records.resource_subtype: Enterprise ML Experiment Tracking & Evaluation Platform
records.notes: Free tier available for academic researchers and individual practitioners. Team and Enterprise plans offer shared team workspaces, dedicated hosting, SSO, and compliance audit logs. W&B Weave tracks LLM application traces.

records.name: MLflow
records.description: Open-source platform under the Linux Foundation for managing the end-to-end machine learning lifecycle. Features experiment tracking, reproducible code packaging (MLflow Projects), model registry, and unified LLM evaluation metrics.
records.resource_subtype: Open-Source Machine Learning Lifecycle Platform
records.notes: Apache 2.0 licensed Linux Foundation project. Founded by Databricks. MLflow 2.0+ features deep LLM evaluation, prompt engineering tracing, and unified gateway integrations alongside classic scikit-learn/PyTorch pipelines.

records.name: OpenTelemetry GenAI Semantic Conventions
records.description: Vendor-neutral open specifications establishing standardized telemetry attributes, metrics, and trace span structures for LLM calls, token usage, embedding generation, temperature parameters, and agent tool invocations.
records.resource_subtype: Industry Standard Semantic Conventions for AI Telemetry
records.notes: Apache 2.0 licensed CNCF specification. Adopted across major monitoring tools (Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, Datadog, New Relic, Honeycomb) to ensure cross-platform compatibility for LLM application metrics.

records.name: Evidently AI
records.description: Open-source Python library for evaluating, testing, and monitoring machine learning and LLM systems in production. Generates visual diagnostic reports for data drift, prediction drift, regression accuracy, and text quality.
records.resource_subtype: Open-Source ML & LLM Monitoring Framework
records.notes: Apache 2.0 licensed. Can be computed locally in Python pipelines or Jupyter notebooks. Evidently Cloud provides enterprise dashboards and automated alerting for production telemetry drifts.

records.name: Giskard
records.description: Open-source Python testing and quality assurance framework for AI models and LLM applications. Automatically scans for hallucinations, prompt injections, data leakage, toxic outputs, and algorithmic bias with automated test generation.
records.resource_subtype: Open-Source AI Testing & Security Vulnerability Scanner
records.notes: Apache 2.0 licensed. Designed to integrate directly into continuous integration (CI) workflows, automatically red-teaming RAG applications and LLM agents prior to production deployment.

records.name: OpenLLMetry
records.description: Open-source telemetry instrumentation library developed by Traceloop. Built natively on OpenTelemetry standards to automatically trace and collect performance spans, prompt inputs, and token usage from OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, and vector databases.
records.resource_subtype: Open-Source OpenTelemetry SDKs for LLM Applications
records.notes: Apache 2.0 licensed. Completely vendor-neutral; telemetry traces can be exported directly into Datadog, Dynatrace, Honeycomb, New Relic, or open-source Jaeger collectors with one line of initialization code.

records.name: TruLens
records.description: Open-source library developed by TruEra for systematically evaluating and tracking LLM applications. Implements the RAG Triad (Context Relevance, Groundedness, Answer Relevance) using feedback functions to guide LLM app optimization.
records.resource_subtype: RAG Triad Evaluation & LLM Feedback Framework
records.notes: Apache 2.0 licensed. Operates TruLens-Eval for evaluating apps during development and TruLens-Explain for deep interpretability. Built-in Streamlit dashboard visualizes pipeline performance scores locally.

records.name: Helicone
records.description: Open-source developer observability platform and proxy for foundation models. Adds one line of code to route LLM requests, delivering real-time request logging, semantic prompt caching, rate limiting, and cost tracking analytics.
records.resource_subtype: Open-Source LLM Observability & Caching Proxy
records.notes: Apache 2.0 licensed core software. Free cloud plan includes 100,000 requests monthly. Pro plan ($20/month) offers extended retention, customer portal features, user segmentation, and automated alerts.

records.name: Portkey
records.description: Ultra-fast, lightweight AI gateway and control plane for enterprise LLM apps. Handles routing across 250+ language models with automatic retries, fallback chains, load balancing, prompt management, and compliance auditing.
records.resource_subtype: AI Gateway & Production LLM Control Panel
records.notes: Open-source AI Gateway written in TypeScript with sub-millisecond overhead. Cloud tier offers 10,000 free requests per month. Enterprise deployments include virtual API keys, SOC 2 compliance, and guardrail enforcement.

records.name: Promptfoo
records.description: Open-source CLI tool and evaluation library for red-teaming, security scanning, and automated quality testing of LLM applications. Evaluates prompt injection vulnerabilities, jailbreak resistance, hallucination rates, and cost across iterations.
records.resource_subtype: CLI & CI/CD Testing Framework for LLM Security & Quality
records.notes: MIT-licensed. Built to run deterministically within GitHub Actions or local terminals. Compares candidate prompts and models side-by-side against test cases using assertions, semantic similarities, and custom LLM grader rubrics.

records.name: AgentOps
records.description: Observability and testing platform built specifically for autonomous AI agents. Tracks multi-agent session replays, agent loop behaviors, tool call execution errors, and token costs with native integrations for CrewAI, AutoGen, and LangGraph.
records.resource_subtype: Observability, Testing & Replay Platform for AI Agents
records.notes: Free tier includes up to 1,000 monthly agent session recordings. Pro ($49/month) and Enterprise tiers unlock unlimited agent replays, regression alerts, human-in-the-loop tracking, and compliance logs.

records.name: Mem0
records.description: Self-improving personalized memory layer for AI agents and LLM applications. Automatically extracts, updates, and retrieves user preferences, past conversational context, and behavioral facts across sessions using graph-based memory structures.
records.resource_subtype: Personalized Long-Term Memory Layer for AI Agents
records.notes: Apache 2.0 licensed open-source framework. Evolved from Embedchain. Mem0 Platform provides a managed cloud API for scalable enterprise agent memory with automated conflict resolution and identity management.

records.name: Letta (formerly MemGPT)
records.description: Open-source framework and agent operating system that manages state and perpetual memory for LLMs. Employs hierarchical memory virtualization (core memory, recall memory, archival memory) enabling agents to edit their own memory indefinitely.
records.resource_subtype: Stateful Agent Operating System & Long-Term Memory Engine
records.notes: Apache 2.0 licensed. Developed out of UC Berkeley research. Rebranded from MemGPT. Exposes persistent agent states over REST APIs and acts as a complete multi-agent backend server with persistent database storage.

records.name: Semantic Kernel
records.description: Enterprise software development kit developed by Microsoft that integrates LLMs with conventional programming languages (C#, Python, Java). Provides enterprise-grade plugins, memory abstractions, native prompt templates, and autonomous agent orchestration.
records.resource_subtype: Enterprise Multi-Language AI Agent SDK
records.notes: MIT-licensed. First-class choice for enterprise .NET ecosystems and Microsoft Copilot extensions. Supports automatic function calling, OpenAPI plugin import, and connectors for Azure OpenAI, Ollama, and Hugging Face.

records.name: PydanticAI
records.description: Python agent framework created by the team behind Pydantic. Built from the ground up for production software engineering, offering type-safe model responses, structured validation, dependency injection, and streaming agent execution.
records.resource_subtype: Type-Safe Python Agent Framework
records.notes: MIT-licensed. Designed to bring software engineering discipline to AI agent design with compile-time type checking, static analysis support, and full compatibility with existing Pydantic validation models.

records.name: Agno (formerly Phidata)
records.description: Pure Python library for building high-speed multi-agent systems with built-in memory, persistent knowledge bases, structured tool calling, and multimodal reasoning capabilities without heavy external framework bloat.
records.resource_subtype: High-Speed Lightweight Multi-Modal Agent Library
records.notes: Open-source library under the Agno Community License. Rebranded from Phidata in late 2024. Emphasizes sub-millisecond framework overhead and native PostgreSQL session storage.

records.name: FastChat
records.description: Open-source platform for training, serving, and evaluating LLM-based conversational chatbots developed by LMSYS. Powers the Chatbot Arena leaderboard, providing distributed multi-model serving backends and OpenAI-compatible web APIs.
records.resource_subtype: Open LLM Training, Serving & Evaluation Platform
records.notes: Apache 2.0 licensed. Backbone technology used to train Vicuna and host dozens of competing community foundation models simultaneously on the public LMSYS Chatbot Arena evaluation platform.

records.name: Aphrodite Engine
records.description: Open-source high-throughput LLM inference engine developed by PygmalionAI. Features PagedAttention, multi-GPU tensor parallelism, speculative decoding, and native support for multiple quantization formats (AWQ, GPTQ, AQLM, GGUF).
records.resource_subtype: High-Throughput Large-Scale LLM Inference Engine
records.notes: Apache 2.0 licensed. Widely utilized as an enterprise-grade inference backend across community cloud providers and OpenRouter inference channels for high-concurrency text serving.

records.name: ExLlamaV2
records.description: High-speed local inference engine written in C++ and CUDA for running quantized language models on modern NVIDIA GPUs. Introduces the EXL2 variable bitrate quantization format to deliver unmatched generation speeds.
records.resource_subtype: Ultra-Fast Local GPU Inference Engine for EXL2 Quantization
records.notes: MIT-licensed. Built by turboderp. Often outpaces competing local inference engines on NVIDIA hardware by optimizing memory bandwidth transfers and utilizing fused CUDA kernels for mixed-precision quantized weights.

records.name: AutoGPT
records.description: Groundbreaking open-source autonomous AI agent platform. Chains LLM thoughts to autonomously pursue complex goals, execute web searches, read/write local files, run code in sandboxes, and benchmark agent task capabilities.
records.resource_subtype: Autonomous AI Agent Framework & Benchmark Platform
records.notes: MIT-licensed. Has evolved beyond the original viral CLI demo into the AutoGPT Forge development framework, Agent Protocol standard, and AutoGPT Arena benchmark for evaluating multi-step autonomous problem solving.

records.name: BabyAGI
records.description: Lightweight open-source AI task management system created by Yohei Nakajima. Uses language models and vector storage to dynamically execute tasks, generate new subsequent tasks based on outcomes, and reprioritize an ongoing task list.
records.resource_subtype: Lightweight Task-Driven Autonomous AI Agent
records.notes: MIT-licensed. Pioneered the core architectural concept of autonomous task-driven agent loops (Task Execution, Task Creation, Task Prioritization) using clean, readable Python code under 150 lines.

records.name: Instructor
records.description: Lightweight Python, TypeScript, and Go library that wraps LLM client APIs to guarantee strictly typed structured outputs and JSON schemas using Pydantic, handling automatic retries, validation hooks, and streaming partial JSON.
records.resource_subtype: Structured Data Extraction & Validation Library
records.notes: MIT-licensed. Created by Jason Liu. Works seamlessly across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Cohere, Groq, and Ollama. When an LLM generates invalid data, Instructor automatically feeds the validation error back to the model for self-correction.

records.name: Vespa
records.description: Open-source production search engine and computation platform capable of scaling to billions of vectors and documents, delivering low-latency hybrid vector search, structured text filtering, and real-time tensor evaluations.
records.resource_subtype: Big Data Vector Search & Hybrid Engine
records.notes: Canonical ID: developer_resource:vespa. Official primary domain: vespa.ai. Verified via public documentation.

records.name: OpenSearch Neural Search
records.description: Core neural search capability within the OpenSearch distributed search engine that simplifies embedding model hosting, vector ingestion pipelines, semantic retrieval, and reciprocal rank fusion with standard BM25 keyword matching.
records.resource_subtype: Hybrid Vector Search & Ingestion Plugin
records.notes: Canonical ID: developer_resource:opensearch-neural. Official primary domain: opensearch.org. Verified via public documentation.

records.name: ScaNN (Scalable Nearest Neighbors)
records.description: Google Research's high-performance library for efficient maximum inner product search (MIPS) and nearest neighbor retrieval, featuring anisotropic vector quantization for maximum recall at extreme queries-per-second throughput.
records.resource_subtype: Vector Quantization & MIPS Library
records.notes: Canonical ID: developer_resource:scann. Official primary domain: github.com. Verified via public documentation.

records.name: DeepSpeed
records.description: Microsoft's open-source deep learning optimization library that implements ZeRO memory partitioning, pipeline parallelism, and high-performance MoE kernels, enabling efficient training and inference of multi-hundred-billion parameter models.
records.resource_subtype: Deep Learning Distributed Optimization Framework
records.notes: Canonical ID: developer_resource:deepspeed. Official primary domain: deepspeed.ai. Verified via public documentation.

records.name: Megatron-LM
records.description: NVIDIA's highly optimized research and production framework for training massive Transformer models at scale using tensor, pipeline, sequence, and expert parallelism across thousands of interconnected NVIDIA GPUs.
records.resource_subtype: Large-Scale Transformer Training Framework
records.notes: Canonical ID: developer_resource:megatron-lm. Official primary domain: nvidia.com. Verified via public documentation.

records.name: Torchtune
records.description: Native PyTorch library providing composable, modular recipes for authoring, fine-tuning, evaluating, and quantizing modern open LLMs using LoRA, QLoRA, full parameter fine-tuning, and memory-efficient distributed backends.
records.resource_subtype: PyTorch Native LLM Fine-Tuning Library
records.notes: Canonical ID: developer_resource:torchtune. Official primary domain: pytorch.org. Verified via public documentation.

records.name: TRL (Transformer Reinforcement Learning)
records.description: Hugging Face's comprehensive post-training library for aligning foundation models using Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), and Kahneman-Tversky Optimization (KTO).
records.resource_subtype: Post-Training Alignment & RLHF Framework
records.notes: Canonical ID: developer_resource:trl. Official primary domain: huggingface.co. Verified via public documentation.

records.name: Llama Guard 3
records.description: Meta AI's open-weights safety classifier model family based on Llama 3 architectures, engineered to detect safety risks across user inputs and LLM outputs, covering hate speech, sexual violence, cyberattacks, and CBRN hazards.
records.resource_subtype: LLM Safety & Guardrail Classifier
records.notes: Canonical ID: developer_resource:llama-guard-3. Official primary domain: ai.meta.com. Verified via public documentation.

records.name: Lakera Gandalf
records.description: Gamified AI security red-teaming platform and threat dataset developed by Lakera to stress-test prompt injection vulnerabilities, jailbreak resistance, and system prompt leakage techniques across thousands of live exploits.
records.resource_subtype: LLM Red Teaming & Prompt Defense Benchmark
records.notes: Canonical ID: developer_resource:lakera-gandalf. Official primary domain: lakera.ai. Verified via public documentation.

records.name: Distilabel
records.description: Argilla's open-source framework for synthesizing, generating, and filtering high-quality datasets for LLM post-training, utilizing automated LLM-as-a-judge pipelines, preference ratings, and multi-turn conversational synthesis.
records.resource_subtype: Synthetic Data Generation & AI Feedback Framework
records.notes: Canonical ID: developer_resource:distilabel. Official primary domain: argilla.io. Verified via public documentation.

records.name: Cleanlab
records.description: Open-source data-centric AI library and automated platform that identifies label errors, semantic anomalies, corrupted records, and near-duplicates across text, tabular, vision, and LLM fine-tuning datasets.
records.resource_subtype: Data-Centric AI & Label Error Detection Library
records.notes: Canonical ID: developer_resource:cleanlab. Official primary domain: cleanlab.ai. Verified via public documentation.

records.name: Snorkel Flow
records.description: Enterprise AI data development platform built on weak supervision and programmatic labeling, enabling engineering teams to create training datasets, align LLMs, and adapt foundation models without manual data annotation.
records.resource_subtype: Programmatic Data Labeling & AI Development Platform
records.notes: Canonical ID: developer_resource:snorkel-flow. Official primary domain: snorkel.ai. Verified via public documentation.

records.name: Smithery
records.description: Central registry and discovery platform for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, providing a searchable directory, one-click installation CLI, and automated compatibility validation for Claude Desktop and Cursor.
records.resource_subtype: Model Context Protocol Registry & CLI
records.notes: Canonical ID: developer_resource:smithery. Official primary domain: smithery.ai. Verified via public documentation.

records.name: Glama MCP
records.description: Comprehensive developer directory and interactive inspector for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, featuring automated security checks, uptime monitors, tool schema viewers, and community developer contributions.
records.resource_subtype: Open MCP Server Directory & Inspector
records.notes: Canonical ID: developer_resource:glama-mcp. Official primary domain: glama.ai. Verified via public documentation.

records.name: Prompt Security
records.description: Comprehensive enterprise AI cybersecurity platform that inspects every prompt and model response in real time to prevent prompt injection, data exfiltration, shadow AI usage, and sensitive intellectual property leaks.
records.resource_subtype: Enterprise GenAI Security Platform & Firewall
records.notes: Canonical ID: developer_resource:prompt-security. Official primary domain: prompt.security. Verified via public documentation.

records.name: Outlines
records.description: Open-source structured generation library that guides LLM sampling to guarantee valid JSON outputs, regular expressions, Context-Free Grammars, and exact Pydantic schemas with zero parsing retries or token hallucination.
records.resource_subtype: Structured Text Generation & Guided Sampling Library
records.notes: Canonical ID: developer_resource:outlines. Official primary domain: dottxt.co. Verified via public documentation.

records.name: Guidance
records.description: Microsoft's open-source programming paradigm for controlling LLMs with interweaved prompt templates, constrained grammar sampling, stateful regex enforcement, and accelerated token prefix caching across model runtimes.
records.resource_subtype: Constrained Generation & Prompt Templating Language
records.notes: Canonical ID: developer_resource:guidance. Official primary domain: microsoft.com. Verified via public documentation.

records.name: LlamaIndex Workflows
records.description: LlamaIndex's event-driven, step-based orchestration framework for developing complex multi-agent architectures, human-in-the-loop loops, and deterministic LLM execution graphs with type-safe state transitions.
records.resource_subtype: Event-Driven AI Agent & Workflow Orchestration
records.notes: MIT licensed; replaces older sequential pipeline abstractions with pure asynchronous event emission and handling.

records.name: LangServe
records.description: Deployment library built on FastAPI that allows developers to deploy LangChain Runnables, agents, and chains as production-ready REST APIs complete with automated streaming endpoints, Pydantic validation, and playground UIs.
records.resource_subtype: LangChain Runnable Deployment REST Framework
records.notes: MIT licensed; provides built-in client SDKs in Python and JavaScript to call deployed endpoints.

records.name: LMCache
records.description: High-performance caching layer for LLM inference engines (like vLLM) that caches and shares key-value (KV) attention states across servers and instances, reducing time-to-first-token (TTFT) by up to 10x for long prompts.
records.resource_subtype: Distributed KV Cache Sharing & Prefill Accelerator
records.notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; supports local host memory, local NVMe SSD storage, and Redis/Ceph distributed backends for KV reuse.

records.name: Aporia
records.description: Enterprise AI guardrails and observability platform that monitors production LLM applications in sub-millisecond real time to intercept hallucinations, enforce corporate data policies, and block adversarial prompt attacks.
records.resource_subtype: Real-Time AI Guardrails & Observability Platform
records.notes: Can sit as a reverse proxy or direct SDK integration into enterprise pipelines; includes live conversation audit logs.

records.name: Lunary
records.description: Open-source developer toolkit for LLM observability, cost tracking, conversation replay, prompt management, and automated evaluation datasets with zero-configuration SDKs for Python, LangChain, and LiteLLM.
records.resource_subtype: Open-Source LLM Analytics & Evaluation Platform
records.notes: Formerly known as LLMonitor; provides both a self-hostable Docker stack and a hosted cloud tier.

records.name: OpenLIT
records.description: Open-source, OpenTelemetry-native observability tool designed for monitoring GenAI models, vector databases, and GPU infrastructure, automatically tracing OpenAI, Anthropic, Chroma, and Qdrant interactions with single-line instrumentation.
records.resource_subtype: OpenTelemetry-Native GenAI & GPU Monitoring
records.notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; exports traces to any standard OTel collector including Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, and New Relic.

records.name: SuperAGI
records.description: Open-source infrastructure framework and graphical console for building, running, and managing autonomous AI agent systems, featuring multi-model support, visual performance telemetry, action consoles, and modular agent skill toolkits.
records.resource_subtype: Infrastructure Platform for Autonomous AI Agents
records.notes: MIT licensed; provides a marketplace for tools and skills and an interactive GUI for monitoring live agent loops.

records.name: AutoGen Studio
records.description: Developer tool and interactive UI built on Microsoft's AutoGen framework that enables developers to rapidly prototype, configure, debug, and run multi-agent workflows with customizable skills and agent teams.
records.resource_subtype: Visual Multi-Agent Prototyping Interface
records.notes: MIT licensed; installs via `pip install autogenstudio` to provide a browser-based agent testing ground.

records.name: Mirascope
records.description: Lightweight Python toolkit for building LLM applications that emphasizes standard software engineering practices, type-safety, colocation of prompts and calls, and seamless switching across frontier LLM providers.
records.resource_subtype: Software Engineering LLM Toolkit
records.notes: MIT licensed; avoids complex callback abstractions, using standard Python classes and Pydantic models.

records.name: FastMCP
records.description: High-level, ergonomic Python framework designed by Jeremiah Lowin (Prefect) for authoring Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers with simple decorators, automatic schema generation, and built-in type validation.
records.resource_subtype: High-Level Python Framework for Model Context Protocol
records.notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; exposes `@mcp.tool` decorators to turn any standard Python function into an MCP-compliant agent tool.

records.name: PyMuPDF4LLM
records.description: Specialized document parsing library developed by Artifex that rapidly extracts text, multi-column tables, equations, and images from PDF documents directly into clean GitHub Flavored Markdown optimized for LLM ingestion.
records.resource_subtype: High-Precision Markdown Extraction for RAG
records.notes: Python package backed by MuPDF's C library; converts PDF pages to markdown up to 100x faster than OCR pipelines.

records.name: Marker
records.description: High-accuracy deep learning pipeline created by Vik Paruchuri that converts complex PDF, EPUB, and MOBI documents into markdown with precise LaTeX equation conversion, tabular structure extraction, and artifact removal.
records.resource_subtype: Deep Learning PDF to Markdown Converter
records.notes: GPL-3.0 licensed; utilizes vision models to correctly segment document layouts and translate inline mathematical equations into KaTeX/LaTeX.

records.name: Unstructured
records.description: Enterprise-grade open-source ingestion and preprocessing framework that transforms raw, unstructured enterprise files (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, HTML, emails) into clean structured text chunks ready for vector database storage.
records.resource_subtype: Ingestion Preprocessing Framework for Enterprise RAG
records.notes: Apache 2.0 open-source library; enterprise SaaS platform provides cloud API connectors to SharePoint, S3, and Google Drive.

records.name: Chonkie
records.description: Lightweight, no-nonsense Python text chunking library engineered for RAG systems, providing fast, tokenizer-aware recursive and semantic chunking with zero heavy external dependencies.
records.resource_subtype: Lightweight Token Chunking Library for RAG
records.notes: MIT licensed; benchmarked to be significantly faster than LangChain's RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter on large document corpora.

records.name: FlashAttention
records.description: Breakthrough GPU kernel engineering library created by Tri Dao that speeds up Transformer attention computations by making attention IO-aware, reducing memory reads/writes between GPU HBM and SRAM to yield 2–4x speedups.
records.resource_subtype: IO-Aware Fast Exact Attention CUDA Kernel
records.notes: BSD-3-Clause licensed; integrated into PyTorch native `scaled_dot_product_attention`, vLLM, and all major LLM training and serving stacks.

records.name: bitsandbytes
records.description: Accessible quantization library for deep learning that provides 8-bit optimizers, LLM.int8() matrix multiplication, and 4-bit NormalFloat (NF4) quantization used in QLoRA to enable fine-tuning 70B models on single consumer GPUs.
records.resource_subtype: 8-bit & 4-bit CUDA Quantization Kernels
records.notes: MIT licensed; standard quantization backend in Hugging Face Transformers and Accelerate.

records.name: AutoGPTQ
records.description: Easy-to-use LLM post-training quantization library based on the GPTQ algorithm, providing fast 2, 3, 4, and 8-bit quantization with specialized CUDA and Triton inference kernels for accelerated local execution.
records.resource_subtype: Post-Training 4-Bit GPU Quantization Library
records.notes: MIT licensed; provides seamless integrations with Hugging Face `transformers` and `optimum` for high-throughput model serving.

records.name: TensorRT
records.description: NVIDIA's foundational inference platform that optimizes neural network models with layer fusion, dynamic tensor memory management, kernel auto-tuning, and FP8/FP16/INT8 precision quantization for GPU inference.
records.resource_subtype: NVIDIA Deep Learning Inference Optimizer & Engine
records.notes: Apache 2.0 open-source components; powers enterprise model serving on NVIDIA GPUs globally.

records.name: ONNX Runtime
records.description: Microsoft's cross-platform inference and training accelerator supporting diverse hardware execution providers (CUDA, TensorRT, DirectML, OpenVINO, CoreML) to run machine learning models at maximum hardware throughput.
records.resource_subtype: Cross-Platform High-Performance Scoring Engine
records.notes: MIT licensed; serves as the runtime backbone for Windows Copilot runtime and cross-platform production deployments.

records.name: OpenVINO
records.description: Intel's open-source toolkit for optimizing and deploying deep learning models on Intel hardware (CPUs, integrated GPUs, discrete GPUs, and NPUs), delivering accelerated AI inference with low footprint.
records.resource_subtype: Open-Source Deep Learning Deployment Toolkit
records.notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; supports LLM quantization via NNCF (Neural Network Compression Framework).

records.name: GGML
records.description: Foundational C/C++ tensor library engineered by Georgi Gerganov that enables high-performance transformer inference on commodity consumer CPUs and Apple Silicon, serving as the foundational computational core for llama.cpp.
records.resource_subtype: Tensor Library for Machine Learning on Commodity Hardware
records.notes: MIT licensed; defines integer quantization formats (Q4_K, Q5_K, Q8_0) that powered the local AI revolution.

records.name: GPT4All
records.description: Open-source privacy-centric desktop application and developer library developed by Nomic AI, allowing users to run consumer-grade quantized LLMs locally on consumer hardware without an internet connection.
records.resource_subtype: Free Local LLM Desktop & Python Ecosystem
records.notes: MIT licensed; includes LocalDocs feature for local document question-answering with private vector embeddings.

records.name: Text Embeddings Inference (TEI)
records.description: High-performance Rust-based toolkit created by Hugging Face for deploying and serving embedding, reranking, and sequence classification models with dynamic batching, Flash Attention, and microsecond latencies.
records.resource_subtype: Blazing-Fast Embedding & Reranking Inference Toolkit
records.notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; delivers up to 10x higher throughput than standard Python-based embedding endpoints.

records.name: DeepSparse
records.description: CPU inference runtime developed by Neural Magic that leverages model weight sparsity and activation pruning to achieve GPU-class execution speeds on standard commodity x86 and ARM processors.
records.resource_subtype: Sparsity-Aware CPU Inference Engine
records.notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; delivers massive speedups for sparse-quantized BERT and LLM architectures on CPUs.

records.name: MLC-LLM
records.description: Universal compilation and runtime framework built on Apache TVM that enables language models to be compiled and deployed natively on any hardware backend including iPhones, Android, WebGPU, and servers.
records.resource_subtype: Universal Machine Learning Compilation Engine
records.notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; compiles native Metal, Vulkan, and WebGPU binaries for client-side zero-server AI execution.

records.name: ChatDev
records.description: Virtual software company simulator where communicative multi-agent roles (CEO, CPO, CTO, programmer, reviewer, tester) collaborate through multi-turn conversations to produce complete software applications.
records.resource_subtype: Communicative Multi-Agent Software Development System
records.notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; developed by OpenBMB and Tsinghua to study communicative social agent paradigms.

records.name: MetaGPT
records.description: Multi-agent meta-programming framework that assigns Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to simulated software agents (architects, engineers, PMs) to generate PRDs, system architectures, and tested codebases.
records.resource_subtype: Multi-Agent Collaborative Framework with SOPs
records.notes: MIT licensed; encodes software engineering SOPs to prevent agent communication degradation in long workflows.

records.name: CAMEL
records.description: First communicative agent framework exploring autonomous role-playing cooperation between conversational LLM agents to autonomously plan, execute, and solve complex human goals with minimal human steering.
records.resource_subtype: Communicative Agents for Mind Exploration Framework
records.notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; pioneers communicative inception prompting to prevent autonomous agents from hallucinating loops.

records.name: SWE-bench
records.description: Rigorous evaluation benchmark created by Princeton University that tests AI coding systems against thousands of real-world GitHub issues and pull requests, requiring agents to solve real bugs and pass unit tests.
records.resource_subtype: Software Engineering Benchmark for Real GitHub Issues
records.notes: MIT licensed; the gold-standard industry benchmark used to score autonomous coding agents like Devin and Claude Code.

records.name: HELM (Holistic Evaluation of Language Models)
records.description: Comprehensive evaluation framework developed by the Stanford Center for Research on Foundation Models (CRFM) assessing language models across accuracy, calibration, robustness, fairness, bias, toxicity, and efficiency.
records.resource_subtype: Holistic Multi-Metric Evaluation Benchmark
records.notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; provides multi-dimensional taxonomies evaluating models on hundreds of diverse scenarios.

records.name: Cloudflare AI Gateway
records.description: Global reverse proxy gateway by Cloudflare that gives developers unified visibility, semantic response caching, rate limiting, and automated fallbacks across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Workers AI providers.
records.resource_subtype: Unified Edge Gateway for Generative AI APIs
records.notes: Free to use on Cloudflare; provides real-time analytics on token usage, latency, and cost reduction through edge caching.

records.name: PromptLayer
records.description: Prompt management and observability platform that logs, version-controls, and evaluates LLM prompt templates across teams, maintaining visual change histories and linking prompts directly to live API requests.
records.resource_subtype: Developer Platform for Prompt Engineering & Evaluation
records.notes: Features visual side-by-side prompt diffing and collaborative template deployment pipelines.

records.name: Agent Protocol
